checks.statement: The two reductions following the underbraced conjugate in the sigma calculation.
checks.event_type: formal algebra check after the visual reading
checks.reasoning: Conditionally on the written underbrace sigma_t g^{-1} sigma_t^{-1}=g, substituting the underbraced term gives g² sigma_t. The corresponding inversion relation gives g² sigma_t=sigma_t g^{-2}.
checks.outcome: The written reduction is internally consistent; this check did not choose the ambiguous group letter.

checks.statement: Odd/even sizes of fibres of the squaring parametrization in a cyclic group of order n.
checks.event_type: elementary arithmetic check after the visual reading
checks.reasoning: In additive residues, solving 2k=c modulo n has gcd(2,n) solutions when solvable and none otherwise. Thus odd n gives one solution for every residue, and even n allows empty fibres or two elements.
checks.outcome: Consistent with the clearly read vides ou de cardinal 2; not used to replace or infer ink.

checks.statement: Kernel identifications and surjective/bijective projection for the written fiber product.
checks.event_type: direct set/group check after the visual reading
checks.reasoning: For P={(x,y):p(x)=q(y)}, the kernel of P→F consists of (x,1) with p(x)=1, and similarly for P→E. If p is onto, every y has some x above q(y); if p is one-to-one and onto, that x is unique.
checks.outcome: The claimed properties fit the read square. The headless written strokes remain headless despite their mathematical map roles.
